description: Defines the OrderAccount entity class with fields, getters, setters, and JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: OrderAccount
classes.description: Entity class representing an order account with start/end dates, billing day, and associated products.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order account.

methods.name: getOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date, cloning the input.

methods.name: getOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end date.

methods.name: setOrderAccountEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date, cloning the input.

methods.name: getOrderAccountProducts
methods.description: Returns the set of associated OrderAccountProduct objects.
